'''Alveolar Fluid''' is a liquid material.

==''Obtainment''==
Alveolar Fluid bottles can be obtained by interacting with [[Alveoli Block|Alveoli Blocks]] with Glass Bottles. It cannot be harvested from Sick Alveoli Blocks, which will apply Poison on contact.

==''Usage''==
The fluid is consumable, applying [[Viral|Viral III]], Haste, and Speed for thirty seconds as well as visibly distorting the screen.<ref>The screen distortion is not an actual "effect" and cannot be removed by Milk. It can be toggled with the "/srp_breathe" command.</ref> Other than this, it can only be brewed in combination with Flint to create bottles of [[Fear]].
